issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台只渲 60f——推进（25–85f）才走一半就结束，穿洞与接管都没进画
推进锚点在 A 的三角字腔，而字腔里是盖板不是洞：推到底撑满画面的是一块盖板三角再淡掉，读不出“穿过字形洞”
盖板是平涂米灰 + 0.3 透明度黑描边，字形洞和盖板明度接近，“洞里有东西”不够醒目
副标是两根灰色骨架条，没有任何章节信息
盖板与页面贴在同一平面，没有厚度与纵深
changes: 补 LETTERFORM_ZOOM_DURATION = 140（0–25 hold · 25–85 推进 · 85–110 落定 · 110–140 静止）；FS 560、scale=28^t、bezier(0.6,0,0.85,0.5) 60f、scale 15–24 撤板、blur÷scale 补偿、B 层 1→1.1→1 dolly 全部保持
推进锚点按渲染帧实测改到 A 横梁洞中心 (778,619)：横梁高 66px×28≈1850 撑满画高，推到底真正是洞吃满全屏，上方三角与下方豁口作为残余盖板上下甩出（md 参数表与已知坑同步）
盖板改为暗场章节字卡（SVG 径向渐变 #1d1e25→#0a0b0e 自带暗角），亮页面在字形洞里成为画面最亮处；字缘 2px 冷白受光边，线宽按 scale 补偿
盖板加按 scale 补偿的 drop-shadow（0 10px 22px），影子落进字洞压在页面上，读作厚板悬于页面之上
副标换成 32px 大写章节行（强调色圆点 + “Chapter 02 / Live dashboards”）；推进前 12–25f 先后吸 1.5% 做预备；全片叠 0.05 颗粒
issuesEn: No duration constant, so the workbench rendered just 60f — the push (25–85f) stopped halfway and neither the dive nor the takeover appeared
The push anchored on A's triangular counter, which is plate, not hole: what filled the screen at the end was a plate triangle fading out, not a dive through a letter-shaped window
The plate was flat beige with a 0.3-opacity black outline, so holes and plate had similar value and the page inside barely stood out
The subtitle was two grey skeleton bars with no chapter information
Plate and page sat on the same plane, with no thickness or depth
changesEn: Added LETTERFORM_ZOOM_DURATION = 140 (0–25 hold · 25–85 push · 85–110 settle · 110–140 hold); FS 560, scale=28^t, bezier(0.6,0,0.85,0.5) over 60f, plate removal at scale 15–24, blur÷scale compensation and the B-layer 1→1.1→1 dolly are unchanged

The push anchor moved to the measured centre of A's crossbar hole (778,619): the 66px bar ×28 ≈ 1850px fills the frame height, so the hole really swallows the screen while the counter above and gap below fly off as leftover plate (md parameter row and pitfall updated)

The plate is now a dark chapter card (SVG radial gradient #1d1e25→#0a0b0e with built-in vignette), making the page inside the letters the brightest thing in frame; letter edges get a 2px cool rim light with scale-compensated width
A scale-compensated drop-shadow (0 10px 22px) on the plate falls into the letter holes onto the page, so the plate reads as a thick slab floating above it
The subtitle is a 32px uppercase chapter line (accent dot + "Chapter 02 / Live dashboards"); a 1.5% pull-back at 12–25f anticipates the push; light 0.05 grain over the shot
